channel.title: E-Bus & Transport Research Feed
channel.description: Daily papers on electric-bus operations, traffic simulation, LLM agents and grid integration

item.title: [8] When does an agentic aggregator add value? Evidence from electric bus depot charging and V2G pricing
item.description: Transportation Research Part C · Ali Eslami, Jônatas Augusto Manzolli, Luis Miranda-Moreno, Jiangbo Yu — Examines an agentic aggregator for e-bus depot charging and V2G pricing, directly matching transport-grid integration and electricity price interests.

item.title: [6] A Convex Value-Function Learning Approach to Coordinating Model-based Distribution Networks with Model-free Microgrids
item.description: IEEE Trans. Smart Grid · Linwei Sang, Yuhang Chen, Ning Guo, Chenhui Lin et al. — Coordinates distribution networks with microgrids via convex value-function learning; useful grid coordination method background.

item.title: [6] Analytical modeling of a stop-less modular bus line: Optimization, feasibility, and economies of scale
item.description: Transportation Research Part E · Haoran Zhao, Neema Nassir, Andres Fielbaum — Analytical modelling and optimisation of a stop-less modular bus line; adjacent to bus operations but not electrification-focused.

item.title: [9] Distributionally robust operational planning for mixed charging and decentralized swapping
item.description: Transportation Research Part E · Jianzhi Leng, Lun Ran, Chi Xie, Cheng Hua — Distributionally robust planning for mixed charging and battery swapping operations is directly on robust optimisation for electric vehicle charging scheduling, central to the researcher's core interests.

item.title: [8] CONSENT: A Negotiation Framework for Leveraging User Flexibility in Vehicle-to-Building Charging under Uncertainty
item.description: AAMAS 2026 · Rishav Sen, Fangqi Liu, Jose Paolo Talusan, Ava Pettet et al. — Negotiation for V2B EV charging flexibility under uncertainty with building costs; directly on charging scheduling and grid-side flexibility.

item.title: [8] EVMapSim: A Network-level Electric Vehicle Charging Simulator
item.description: AAMAS 2026 · Prokopis Georgiou, Jayati Deshmukh, Vahid Yazdanpanah, Sebastian Stein et al. — Discrete-event simulator of national-scale EV charging with station failures and queues; directly relevant to charging infrastructure and scheduling reliability.

item.title: [8] Episode Spaces: Mining Reusable Knowledge from Urban Simulation Corpora for Safety-Critical Decision Support
item.description: KDD 2026 · Roman Sultimov, Daniil Efimov, Mikhail Kuzin, Ivan Novikov et al. — Mines reusable decision episodes from SUMO urban evacuation simulations for safety-critical traffic decisions; closely matches simulation-based multi-agent decision support.

item.title: [8] Unified Provisioning of Energy and Transportation Service Flexibility with E-taxi Fleets: A Dual Perspective
item.description: ACM e-Energy 2026 · Liangkai Zhou, Yue Zhao, Shan Lin — Joint e-taxi fleet charging and passenger service flexibility under disruptions using LP; directly on EV fleet charging and transport-energy coupling.

item.title: [8] UrbanMix: LLM-Guided Simulation of Mixed Autonomy Traffic with Heterogeneous Behavioral Profiles
item.description: IJCAI 2026 · Roman Sultimov, Daniil Efimov, Ivan Novikov, Aleksandr Volkov et al. — SUMO-based mixed-autonomy traffic simulation with LLM policy coordinator on real Austin networks; close to the researcher's simulation and LLM interests.

item.title: [8] A Deep Reinforcement Learning Framework for Real-Time Electric Vehicle Charging Management in IoEV-Enabled Smart Cities
item.description: arXiv cs.LG · Nour-Eddine Moumni, Rachid Alaoui, Driss Kiouach — DQN-based EV charging station selection evaluated in SUMO on OpenStreetMap networks with charging station heterogeneity and outages, closely matching the researcher's EV charging simulation work.

item.title: [7] BusEnv: A Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning Environment and Benchmark for Urban Public Transportation
item.description: AAMAS 2026 · Wesley da Silva e Silva, Ricardo Araújo Rios, Rafael da C. Fonseca, Sabarikirishwaran Ponnambalam et al. — Multi-agent RL benchmark for bus operations built on real transit data with energy metrics; close to the researcher's bus simulation and sustainability interests.

item.title: [7] Charging Station Placement for Anonymous Mobile Agents: A Parameterized Complexity Perspective
item.description: IJCAI 2026 · Arun Kumar Das, Tesshu Hanaka, Nikolaos Melissinos, Hirotaka Ono — Charging station placement for mobile agents with range limits; closely matches charging-infrastructure and range-constrained routing problems.

item.title: [7] Multi-Agent Pointer Transformer: Seq-to-Seq Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Vehicle Dynamic Pickup-Delivery Problems
item.description: AAAI 2026 · Zengyu Zou, Jingyuan Wang, Yixuan Huang, Junjie Wu — Seq-to-seq RL for multi-vehicle dynamic pickup-delivery routing with stochastic requests, close to fleet dispatch problems the researcher works on.

item.title: [7] Multiagent System for Dynamic Multicriteria Traffic Routing in Urban Environments
item.description: AAMAS 2026 · Temirlan Kurbanov, Adéla Kubíková, Jiří Vořínek, Franziska Klügl — Multiagent dynamic routing evaluated in SUMO on city-scale scenarios with traffic prediction; close to the researcher's simulation and optimisation work.

item.title: [7] Strategic Interactions in Multi-Level Stackelberg Games with Non-Follower Agents and Heterogeneous Leaders
item.description: AAMAS 2026 · Niloofar Aminikalibar, Farzaneh Farhadi, Maria Chli — Stackelberg model of EV charging infrastructure competition with congestion coupling; relevant to charging infrastructure and mobility-energy markets.

item.title: [7] Silent Reward and Environment Defects in EV Charging Simulation Benchmarks: A Diagnostic Checklist
item.description: arXiv cs.LG · Nour-Eddine Moumni, Rachid Alaoui, Driss Kiouach — Audits SUMO-based RL benchmarks for EV charging assignment, exposing silent simulation defects directly relevant to reliable charging simulation studies.

item.title: [6] Auditable Institutional Coordination with Episodic Memory for Robust Evacuation under Multi-Source Disruption
item.description: AAMAS 2026 · Roman Sultimov — Institutional coordination for evacuation in SUMO with topology shift and robustness; adjacent to traffic simulation and LLM-free coordination.

item.title: [6] Autonomous Vehicles need Social Awareness to Find Optima in Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning Routing Games

item.title: [6] BulkShield: A Proactive Framework for Detecting Bulk Refund Booking in Ticketing Systems
item.description: KDD 2026 · Seungyoung Shin, Donggeun Oh, Yongho Jeon, Jinju Noh et al. — Sequential behaviour-based detection of bulk refund booking in railway ticketing with LLM explanations; public transport analytics with LLM-assisted interpretation.

item.title: [6] CityReal: Human-Aligned Urban Behavior and City Dynamics Simulation with Large-Scale LLM Agents
item.description: EMNLP 2026 · Nicolas Bougie, Xiaotong Ye, Narimasa Watanabe — LLM-agent urban mobility simulation at city scale with calibration to population statistics; relevant to simulation calibration and LLM agents.

item.title: [6] CityWeave: Weaving User Needs and World Constraints for Personalized and Reliable Mobility Planning
item.description: KDD 2026 · Ao Wang, Zhiwen Chen, Shen Wang, Qiang Xia et al. — VLM-based door-to-door mobility planning with routing tools; adjacent to LLM-plus-routing agents for urban transport.

item.title: [6] Column Generation for the Micro-Transit Zoning Problem
item.description: IJCAI 2026 · Hins Hu, Rishav Sen, Jose Paolo Talusan, Abhishek Kumar Dubey et al. — Exact column generation with pricing heuristics for micro-transit zoning; methodologically close to branch-and-price work, though not electrified fleets.

item.title: [6] Forecasting What Matters: Decision‑Focused RL for Controlled EV Charging with Unknown Departure Times
item.description: ACM e-Energy 2026 · Giuseppe Gabriele, Fabio Pavirani, Seyed Soroush Karimi Madahi, Chris Develder — RL EV charging with forecasted unknown departure times; relevant to charging control under uncertainty but not bus-specific.

item.title: [6] LLM-Guided Multi-Agent Evacuation Coordination via Episodic Memory and Cognitive Task Analysis
item.description: AAMAS 2026 · Roman Sultimov, Aleksandr Volkov, Mile Mitrovic, Yury Maximov — LLM Commander issuing routing decisions in a multi-agent evacuation simulation; relevant to LLM agents for transit/emergency decisions, though wildfire focus differs.

item.title: [6] LLM-to-Map: Transparent Conversational Tool Orchestration for Real-Time Multi-Domain Simulation
item.description: IJCAI 2026 · Marouane Benbrahim, Kavya Gautam, Zonghan Zhang, Zhiqian Chen — LLM tool orchestration coupling SUMO traffic with PyPSA power flow and V2G for EV charging stress; relevant to agent pipelines and grid integration.

item.title: [6] Learning-Based Policy Design for Resource Planning and Pricing in Heterogeneous Multi-Leader-Multi-Follower Systems
item.description: AAMAS 2026 · Niloofar Aminikalibar — Multi-leader-multi-follower pricing and resource planning motivated by EV charging; relevant to charging economics and grid-facing decisions.

item.title: [6] Local Rules, Global Efficiency: Emergent Coordination on Large-Scale Road Networks
item.description: KDD 2026 · Zhenhui Jessie Li — Emergent AV coordination on large road networks; relevant to traffic simulation at city scale, though without electrification or bus focus.

item.title: [6] Managing modular bus operations in a hub-and-spoke network
item.description: Transportation Research Part C · Yuxi Liu, Hua Wang, Shuai Jia — Modular bus operations in a hub-and-spoke network from Transportation Research Part C; likely relevant to bus fleet operations, though no abstract is available.

item.title: [6] Optimal Solutions for the Moving Target Vehicle Routing Problem via Branch-and-Price with Relaxed Continuity
item.description: ICAPS 2026 · Anoop Bhat, Geordan M. Gutow, Zhongqiang Ren, Sivakumar Rathinam et al. — Exact branch-and-price with labeling for vehicle routing with moving targets; shares column generation and pricing methods used in their scheduling work.

item.title: [6] Optimizing Ride-Pooling Operations with Extended Pickup and Drop-Off Flexibility
item.description: AAAI 2026 · Hao Jiang, Yixin Xu, Pradeep Reddy Varakantham — Ride-pooling matching with flexible pickup points is adjacent vehicle routing with sustainability framing, useful background for fleet scheduling methods.

item.title: [6] Optimizing Urban Route Choice for Autonomous Vehicles using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
item.description: AAMAS 2026 · Anastasia Psarou — MARL routing of AVs in microscopic traffic with human drivers and social rewards; adjacent to routing/simulation work but not electric buses.

item.title: [6] ProcessLight: Process Supervision for Large Language Model Based Traffic Signal Control
item.description: EMNLP 2026 · Huaitao Zhao, Tianlong Zhou, Weijie Wang, Jiasheng Shi et al. — LLM reasoning with step-level RL for traffic signal control; LLM-based traffic decision-making adjacent to the researcher's interests.

item.title: [6] TRACER: Physics-Guided Causal Evidence Construction for Zero-Shot Traffic Anomaly Diagnosis
item.description: KDD 2026 · Yuhang Zhang, Meng Ma, Ping Wang — Zero-shot LLM agent diagnosing traffic congestion root causes validated on SUMO; relevant to LLM agents in transport operations.

item.title: [6] TrafficPDE: A Guidebook to Deployable AI-Driven Transportation Systems Through the Perception-Decision-Explanation Triangle
item.description: IJCAI 2026 · Ziyue Li — Practitioner guidebook on deployable ITS AI covering perception, RL transfer, and explanation; broad background for the researcher.

item.title: [6] USPR: Learning a Unified Solver for Profiled Routing
item.description: AAAI 2026 · Chuanbo Hua, Federico Berto, Zhikai Zhao, Jiwoo Son et al. — Learning-based unified solver for profiled vehicle routing with vehicle-client constraints; adjacent to constrained fleet routing.

item.title: [6] Multi-Modal Multi-Agent System for Bridge Operation and Maintenance based on Large Language Model

item.title: [8] Infrastructure planning for inductive charging in electrified shuttle systems
item.description: Transportation Research Part C · Paul Bischoff, Salma Hammani, Maximilian Schiffer — Infrastructure planning for inductive charging in electrified shuttle systems directly addresses electric transit charging infrastructure decisions.

item.title: [6] A real-time transit signal priority control method based on stochastic shockwave profile model for multi-line bus systems
item.description: Transportation Research Part E · Pengjie Liu, Yanzhan Chen, Ruiguang Liu, Fan Yu et al. — Real-time transit signal priority for multi-line bus systems using stochastic shockwave modelling; relevant bus operations control with adjacent simulation methods.

item.title: [6] Learning-oriented approach for integrated charging load prediction and mobile charging station scheduling
item.description: Computers & Operations Research · Ming Liu, Lutian Wang, Lihua Sun, Feifeng Zheng — Integrates charging load prediction with mobile charging station scheduling; relevant to charging scheduling and learning-augmented optimisation, though not explicitly electric buses.

item.title: [9] Voltage Safety-Aware EV Charging Coordination in Distribution Network via Graph-Enhanced Safe MARL with Dedicated Critics
item.description: IEEE Trans. Transportation Electrification · Chenghao Huang, Jiarong Fan, Weiqing Wang, Hao Wang — Graph-enhanced safe multi-agent RL for EV charging coordination with voltage safety in distribution networks, directly on the grid integration problem.

item.title: [8] Electric Vehicle Scheduling and Carbon-Aware Energy Dispatch for Charging Stations
item.description: arXiv eess.SY · Fulong Yao, Yiming Xu, Maurizio Albano, Liana Cipcigan et al. — Greedy vehicle scheduling and TD3 battery dispatch for charging stations with PV and carbon-aware costs, directly relevant to charger scheduling and energy cost.

item.title: [7] Cooperative EV Charging Assignment Using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning: A Comparison of QMIX and Independent Q-Learning Under Urban Traffic Uncertainty
item.description: arXiv cs.MA · Nour-Eddine Moumni, Rachid Alaoui, Driss Kiouach — QMIX versus IQL multi-agent RL for EV charging assignment across stations in SUMO, a clear method and application match.

item.title: [7] Dual-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Vehicle Scheduling and Multi-Energy Dispatch in Electric-Hydrogen-Transport Systems
item.description: arXiv eess.SY · Fulong Yao, Yiming Xu, Maurizio Albano, Liana Cipcigan et al. — Couples electric bus-like vehicle scheduling with multi-energy dispatch using RL, directly touching the researcher's scheduling and energy-coupling interests.

item.title: [6] Chance constrained optimization of hub transport systems

item.title: [6] Electrified cross-carrier platooning for long-haul freight: Charging coordination and stable cost allocation
item.description: Transportation Research Part D · Rui Zheng, Yu Zhou, Chuan Ding, Mi Gan et al. — Electrified freight platooning with charging coordination and cost allocation shares optimisation and charging themes, though it targets long-haul trucks.

item.title: [6] Algebraic World Model: From Exploration to Proofs
item.description: arXiv cs.AI · Guancheng Pan, Qixin Tan, Yang Yuan, Andrew Chi-Chih Yao — LLM-driven world-model construction with Lean proofs for reachability; a generic agent paper with limited transport or OR overlap despite its agentic framing.

item.title: [6] Distribution Grid Reconfiguration and Restoration via Linearizable Multi-phase Power Flow Modeling
item.description: arXiv eess.SY · Young-ho Cho, Hao Zhu — MILP-compatible neural power-flow model for distribution network reconfiguration and restoration; relevant to grid integration and MILP formulations.

item.title: [6] GNN-Guided Network Reduction for Centralized Urban Traffic Routing
item.description: arXiv cs.LG · Nikolai Antonov, Lukáš Chrpa, Andrii Nyporko, Jan Hůla — GNN-guided network reduction for MILP-based urban traffic routing; traffic-optimisation methods that the researcher may find useful.

item.title: [6] LLM-Assisted Optimization for Simulation-Based Redesign
